name: Ganesh Green Bharat Ltd.
summary: Ganesh Green Bharat Ltd. operates as an engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) company, specializing in the renewable energy sector, electrical infrastructure, and water supply projects across India. The company manufactures solar PV modules, including monocrystalline, HJT, and TOPCON types, and provides comprehensive solar energy solutions such as solar panels, inverters, storage systems, solar street lighting, and solar water pumps for both on-grid and off-grid applications. In the electrical infrastructure domain, it offers services including overhead and underground transmission and distribution lines, street lighting, and substations. The company also undertakes water supply schemes and projects, including solar-powered water pumps and establishing water connections. Ganesh Green Bharat Ltd. has expanded its focus to include Battery Energy Storage Systems and also engages in the manufacturing of lithium batteries for various applications. Additionally, the company provides sustainability consulting, environmental impact assessments, and research and development services for smart meters and e-vehicles. Its primary target markets encompass residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural, and government sectors throughout India, with a notable engagement in government schemes aimed at solarizing agriculture and rural water supply.
